item.tib: skyabs mgon bla sgrub kyi tshogs bskang tam bu ra
item.coloph: sum ldan bla bskang sum brgya drug cu'i tshig shes ldan tshul rgyan shes rab phun tshogs sogs/ nye 'bang slob mas nyer bar bskal ba'i ngor/ tshul tsam mi shes tshul rgyan kho bo ches/ snyan du re ba'i snyan ngag brda las drangs/ zab par 'dod nas zab pa'i don dang sbyar/ rdzogs byang dmigs te rdzogs pa gsum gyi nyin/ smin 'bras legs snyoms smin grol khang du bris//
